title: OPTIMIZING THE TREATMENT WITH MEROPENEM FOR FOREIGN-BODY BONE AND JOINT INFECTIONS
official: OPTIMIZING THE TREATMENT WITH MEROPENEM FOR FOREIGN-BODY BONE AND JOINT INFECTIONS: PLASMA/BONE PHARMACOKINETICS WITH CONTINUOUS VS INTERMITTENT INFUSION
summary: Main objective: To describe the plasma and bone tissue concentration-time profiles of meropenem administered by continuous (CI) or intermittent infusion (II) in patients with foreign-body bone and joint infections (FB-BJI).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Fulfilling criteria for FB-BJI
2. Able to be randomised after FB-BJI diagnosis.
3. Age ≥18 years.
4. Patient or legal representative is able to provide informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known or suspected allergy or intolerance to meropenem.
2. Severe chronic kidney failure defined as glomerular filtration rate (GFR) <  30mL/min.
3. Pregnant patients or lactating mothers.
4. Patients with spine instrumentation infections, since the anatomical  characteristics of vertebral bone are different from those of long bones.
5. Patients undergoing limb amputation.
6. Failure to obtain the informed consent for participating in the study.
7. Previous enrolment in this trial.
sponsor: Consorci Mar Parc De Salut De Barcelona
